expect.arrive: 8-10 min walk from Belltown; market opens early and is already busy with vendors by 8:30am, before tour groups arrive.
expect.parking: Walk from the Belltown Airbnb, no transit needed.

paths.do: Stay under the market's covered arcades (Main and North Arcade) the whole time; Post Alley and the Gum Wall are also covered.
Cover the main arcades, Post Alley, Gum Wall, and the waterfront side stalls below.

expect.arrive: About 25 min on foot from the market, downhill then flat; Pioneer Square is quiet mid-morning, mostly local foot traffic.
expect.parking: Walk from Pike Place, no transit needed.

paths.do: Klondike Gold Rush museum is free and indoors; linger there, then a quick look at the Pioneer Square buildings from under awnings.
Museum, wander the square's ironwork storefronts, then Salumi for lunch (expect a short queue; cash only).

alt: Klondike Gold Rush National Historical Park Seattle interior

expect.arrive: Seattle Center is a 15-20 min walk or a short bus/monorail ride from Pioneer Square; Chihuly Garden and Glass is fully indoor/glasshouse so it's a good rainy-afternoon stop.
expect.parking: Monorail from Westlake Center (2 min ride) or walk from downtown.

paths.do: Chihuly Garden and Glass galleries and glasshouse, skip the Space Needle, walk back to Belltown to collect bags.
Chihuly first, then Space Needle observation deck (book a timed slot in advance), then walk back for bags.

d11s3.cost: Chihuly Garden and Glass adult admission is about $40-45 USD (chihulygardenandglass.com, read 2026-09-12). Space Needle adult admission ranges $35-55 USD depending on time/season, with timed entry every 15 min (spaceneedle.com, read 2026-09-12) - book ahead, especially for a specific arrival window.
d11s3.seasonal: Monday hours: Chihuly Garden and Glass 10:30am-6:30pm; Space Needle 10:30am-8:00pm. Both open on Mondays, no weekday closure to plan around.

expect.arrive: Bags in hand from Belltown; bus stop at Wall St & 5th Ave has frequent service, or a 10-15 min Uber/taxi in light traffic.
expect.parking: Bus from Wall St & 5th Ave (16 min, every 15 min) or rideshare direct to King Street Station.

paths.do: Wall St & 5th Ave bus to King Street Station; buses have limited luggage space at busy times.
Uber/Lyft direct to the station door, easiest with two bags in the rain.

d11s4.seasonal: Arrive by 5:00pm for the 6:00pm departure (Amtrak recommends 45 min before departure to check bags, more time if queues are long). Canadian customs/border check happens on arrival at Pacific Central Station in Vancouver around 10:00pm, not before boarding in Seattle.

expect.arrive: 26 min on the Expo Line from Renfrew-Collingwood to Waterfront Station, then a 5-10 min walk into Gastown; morning crowds are light before 10am.
expect.parking: Expo Line to Waterfront Station, then walk.

paths.do: Duck into Revolver Coffee, browse covered storefronts, then walk to Chinatown for a sit-down lunch at Phnom Penh or Bao Bei.
Steam Clock, Gastown streets, walk to Chinatown via the Millennium Gate, browse, then lunch.

expect.arrive: Walk from downtown along Coal Harbour into the park (about 20-25 min from Waterfront Station); the seawall is flat, paved, and exposed to wind/rain off the water with little shelter.
expect.parking: Walk from downtown via Coal Harbour, or take the #19 bus to the Stanley Park entrance to shorten the approach.

paths.opt: Coal Harbour to Brockton Point and back
paths.do: Marina walk, totem poles, turn around before Second Beach if it's pouring or windy.
The complete 9km loop around Stanley Park back to the start; longer than most visitors expect and offers little rain cover.

trail.from: Coal Harbour / Devonian Harbour Park entrance

d12s2.seasonal: Vancouver Park Board states the Stanley Park seawall loop is about 9 km and takes 2-3 hours to walk (vancouver.ca, read 2026-09-12). Given rain and luggage-free legs that day, the shorter Coal Harbour-to-Brockton Point turnaround is the realistic default; the full loop is a fair-weather option only.

expect.arrive: 10-15 min walk from Stanley Park's south side or the seawall; English Bay gets breezy at sunset, no shelter on the beach itself.
expect.parking: Walk along the seawall from Stanley Park, or bus down Denman/Davie if legs are tired.

paths.do: Skip the beach sit, walk Denman Street for dinner options, duck in early at Joe Fortes.
Watch sunset at English Bay Beach near the A-maze-ing Laughter sculptures, then dinner nearby.

expect.arrive: Walk from the Mount Pleasant Airbnb, no transit needed; Main Street cafes are quiet before 9am on a weekday.
Walk or short bus to the False Creek dock, then the Aquabus mini-ferry across to Granville Island (about 5 min crossing, runs every few minutes); the market itself is indoors under one roof.
expect.parking: Aquabus or False Creek Ferries mini-ferry from downtown/Yaletown docks, or the #50 bus direct to Granville Island.

paths.do: Public Market food stalls, Lee's Donuts, Oyama Sausage counter; fully indoors, good if raining.
Market first, then a short tasting flight at Granville Island Brewing next door.

d15s2.cost: Granville Island Public Market has no admission fee. Individual vendor prices apply; the market is reported open daily 9am-7pm in the April-October season (granvilleisland.com and secondary listings, read 2026-09-12) - not independently confirmed from the official page directly, worth a quick check closer to the date.

expect.arrive: Yaletown is a 15-20 min walk from Granville Island via the Cambie or Granville bridges, or a short Aquabus/ferry hop plus walk; the Vancouver Art Gallery is downtown, a further 10-15 min walk or a couple SkyTrain/bus stops.

paths.do: Vancouver Art Gallery, fully indoors, an easy way to burn the time before heading to bags and the station.
Walk the Yaletown waterfront path, browse converted-warehouse shops and cafes.

d15s3.cost: Vancouver Art Gallery adult admission is $29 CAD (BC resident rate) to $35 CAD (non-resident); Friday hours 10am-8pm (vanartgallery.bc.ca, read 2026-09-12).
d15s3.seasonal: Vancouver Art Gallery is closed on Tuesdays - not a conflict for day 15 (Friday), but relevant if plans shift; day 12 (Tuesday) does not currently include the gallery, which is correct given the closure.

expect.arrive: About 24 min by transit from Mount Pleasant to Pacific Central Station with bags; US immigration preclearance happens here, before boarding, not on arrival in Seattle.
expect.parking: SkyTrain (Main St-Science World or Broadway-City Hall) or bus/rideshare with luggage.

paths.do: SkyTrain to Main St-Science World, short walk to Pacific Central Station.
Uber/Lyft direct to the station door, simplest with luggage in the rain.

d15s4.seasonal: US Customs and Border Protection preclearance for southbound trains is done at Pacific Central Station before boarding (Amtrak/WSDOT, read 2026-09-12); arrive at least 60 minutes before departure, and be seated at least 15 minutes before the train leaves. Checked baggage generally needs to be presented about 45 minutes before departure - the day file's 3:40pm arrival for a 4:55pm departure gives 75 minutes, which comfortably covers both. No stop in Blaine, WA is needed anymore under the new preclearance arrangement (as of June 2026).
